text:
Sana: Heads up — I'll kick off the billing.events_v2 schema migration at 2024-06-12 00:30 PT. Plan: canary -> gradual roll -> backfill. Holdpoint before full TTL backfill. Please ack and pin service version 1.3.4 for the window.

DeployBot: Scheduled canary start at 2024-06-12T00:30:00Z. Canary hosts: service-01, service-02. Holdpoint set: "pre-backfill-quiesce". Reply with `:ack:` to confirm.

Eli: ack. What's expected lock duration for the DDL?

Sana: DDL is an ADD COLUMN with default NULL + index create concurrently. Expected exclusive lock only for ~2s on txn boundary; main risk is backfill I/O. Quiesce will reduce write traffic.

Monica: quick rollback plan in case of issues: run `./scripts/rollback_mig.sh billing.events_v2 1.3.3` then scale down backfill workers: `kubectl scale deployment backfill --replicas=0` and revert service pin. Keep that handy.

Jason: adding to release notes: "billing.events_v2: add event_type column + index; start gradual backfill; risk: transient replica lag during backfill." Also pinning 1.3.4 for deployments in the window.

DeployBot: Canary started. Logs: `canary: service-01 ok, service-02 ok`. Health checks: 200/200. Holdpoint reached: pre-backfill-quiesce. Waiting for manual go.

ops-oncall: quick escalation criteria: abort if CPU > 70% on any db-primary for 3 consecutive 1m windows OR error-rate on write path > 5% for 5m. Also abort if replica lag > 120s.

Eli: observed replica lag spike to 30s during initial index build on canary — expected. Monitoring looks stable now.

Sana: metrics look green for 5m. Proceeding to 10% rollout and starting backfill workers (scale=2). Triggering canary -> 10% now.

DeployBot: Rollout to 10% applied. Backfill-worker pods: 2 -> starting. Backfill progress: 0.8% rows processed.

ops-oncall: reminder: if errors trend up, use `kubectl annotate deployment billing-events canary-paused=true` to hit pause and DeployBot will stop progressing.

Monica: noted. If we need hard-stop, `./ops/kill-backfill.sh <job-id>` (job-id visible in backfill logs).

Sana: hitting the 50% gate in ~20m if no regressions. anyone object to proceeding?

Eli: no objections from infra.

Jason: no objections from product. Put a short blurb in #release-notes when full rollout completes.

DeployBot: 50% rollout initiated at 2024-06-12T00:58:00Z. Backfill now at 12.4%.

ops-oncall: keeping watch. I'll jump in if errors exceed thresholds.

Sana: final: if we need to rollback at any stage, use the rollback script Monica posted and set service pin back to 1.3.3. I'll post a short postmortem if we cut. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Eli: ack :thumbsup: 

Jason: ack

Monica: ack
